sql.attachment.getTypesForCompany: select * from flow.attachment_type where company_id = :companyId and archived is not true
sql.attachment.getType: select id, attachment_type, company_id, archived from flow.attachment_type where company_id = :companyId and id = :typeId order by attachment_type.attachment_type;
sql.attachment.deleteType: update flow.attachment_type set archived = true where id = :id
sql.attachment.updateType: update flow.attachment_type set attachment_type = :attachmentType where id = :id
